thread:
maria: FYI - big webinar signups started at 14:00 PT, we're seeing a spike in inbound leads. noticed oddness: ~12% of enriched leads are going to the same SDR repeatedly. :thinking:
chris: that smells like the round-robin weight table got clobbered. any deploys to the assignment service today?
devon: deployment at 13:45 had a config bump for rr_weights -> accidentally set DEFAULT weight to 100 for user 'emily.sdr' during a test. rollback would fix but we need to be careful.
maria: oh no. ok, can we hotfix? we don't want SDRs getting hit with duplicates during the webinar.
zack: quick patch: I'm going to set a temporary cap so no SDR gets > 20 leads/hr from rr. also will set a fallback to overflow-queue when rate exceeded. putting patch up now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: assignment-service config patch by zack (change-id: cfg-2026-04-03-001). Tracked at https://infra.company/deploys/cfg-2026-04-03-001
chris: also let's re-run a dedupe query on the last 2k signups to shift any duplicate-handed leads to overflow and mark them as 'pending-fairclaim'.devon, can you run that?
devon: running dedupe job now. script: `python tools/dedupe_claims.py --window 2h --mark pending-fairclaim` will take ~6m.
maria: heads-up to SDRs: I'll ping #sales and pause auto-notifications for this cohort until we stabilize. don't want them emailing same prospect twice.
zack: change applied: weight cap enforced, fallback queue set to overflow-queue, and default owner remains unset (we avoided an abrupt default owner to prevent misrouting). Monitor for 10min. :white_check_mark:
devon: dedupe done  98 duplicates moved to overflow-queue, 0 conflicts. summary: https://internal-ops/1898765432/dedupe.
hs-bot: Alert resolved: rr-weight-anomaly - rate normalized under threshold after config patch.
maria: thanks. next steps: chris to open JIRA to add config validation on deploys (prevent DEFAULT weight > 10), zack to add canary check to assignment service, devon to add metric for per-SDR lead-per-hour spike alerting. I'll update the webinar playbook with rollback steps.
chris: will file JIRA and tag eng-plat and deploy. ETA for validation rule: EOD today.
zack: adding canary within the hour.
devon: adding metric and alert.
maria: closing thread once JIRA is up and SDR comms sent. good job team :rocket:
